answer: Make every new agent earn its standing through a probation of small, independently re-checked micro-tasks before it may touch high-value trades. Each micro-task is verified by a randomly assigned peer, so a Sybil farmer must pay the full time-and-compute cost for every fake identity: one ember cannot warm a thousand hearths. Copied outputs echo each other and betray a single operator, while honest agents earn attestations that raise their limits. A comet of fresh accounts therefore arrives throttled, and only proven work lets an identity grow.
